description: Multiplies or divides one incoming clock by three independent factors at once. Each factor is a figure on the panel, with the resulting rate shown in Hz and in BPM

params.text: Switches the three factors from multiplying the incoming clock to dividing it
Switches all three rows on and off

inputs.text: The clock that is multiplied or divided
A pulse resets all three rows
A voltage switches all three rows on and off

notes: a row's factor is set by dragging its red display, from 0.01 to 99.9999, rather than with a knob.
the green lamp lights while the reading of the incoming tempo has settled.
menu: No CLOCK OUT If No CLOCK IN Connected — holds the outputs silent while nothing is patched to the clock input
